title_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Art N'Lagje, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte !!
description_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Ish-Profarma, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !! Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 70.6 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallon dhe kuzhine , dhoma e gjumit me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti. Orientohet nga Veri Perendimi dhe ka organizim perfekt, me hapesira te bollshme. Apartamenti lokalizohet ne nje zone te kualifikuar dhe te re ne aspektin e infrastruktures, si dhe nje ndertim i ri teper cilesor i perfunduar, me punime bashkekohore ku vihet re termoizolimi i fasades, vetrata te pajisura me dopio xham termik, izolim akustik, sistemet hidraulike te markes Geberit, instalime per sistem qendror ngrohje - ftohje kondicionim multisplit, tre ashensore te nje nder markave me te njohura ne treg. Ndertimi sapo ka filluar dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda afatit 2 vjecar.
title_en: Bargain price! At Art in the neighborhood, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect floor plan!!
description_en: Bargain price! At the former Profarma, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!! The apartment has a total area of ​​70.6 m2 and is organized with a corridor that divides the living room and kitchen, the bedroom with access to the balcony and the toilet. It is oriented from the North West and has a perfect organization, with ample spaces. The apartment is located in a qualified and new area in terms of infrastructure, as well as a new, high-quality construction, with contemporary works where thermal insulation of the facade is noted, windows equipped with thermal double glazing, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of the Geberit brand, installations for a central heating - cooling multisplit system, three elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market. The construction has just started and is expected to be completed within 2 years.
